## Problem Statement

## Sovereignty Check

> NEX is governed by constitutional specifications. Please consider:

- [ ] This feature **does not** introduce a parallel identity, permission, sync, storage, trust, discovery, capability, or networking architecture when a NEX platform service already exists
- [ ] This feature **respects** the 8-level authority hierarchy
- [ ] This feature **does not** require changes to frozen contracts (WIRE-v1, WAL-v1, C ABI v1)

**Which constitutional level does this affect?**
- [ ] Level 6-8 (Implementation / Tests / Experimental) — standard review
- [ ] Level 3-5 (ADRs / Gates / FFI contracts) — architectural review required
- [ ] Level 1-2 (Constitution / Frozen contracts) — cannot be changed
